component.name: Diagnostics
component.summary: systemd boot, unit, crash, findings, service hardening, and unit verification for Cockpit

description.p: Shows current-boot timing, systemd-analyze plot, unit activation duration, the systemd critical chain, currently failed units, coredumps, conservative current-boot findings such as out-of-memory kills and high-priority kernel events, systemd-analyze security exposure for system services, and systemd-analyze verify findings for installed unit files. It links to Cockpit Services and Logs instead of duplicating those pages. The security page reports sandboxing settings; it is not a vulnerability scanner. Verification does not edit units.
